name: ai-interview-agent
description: Enterprise Multi-Turn AI Technical Interviewer Agent

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && cd backend && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && node dist/index.js
